title: A Sudden Awakening of the Machines

sentences.text: The air hung still within the house until 05:40, when the machines began their shift, a strange energy gathering.
The machines waking up was marked by an immense spike, as the observed 380 Wh soared far past the expected 36 Wh to 75 Wh range.
At 05:40, the appliances registered this dramatic power surge, feeling as though the house itself was jolting awake.
This powerful presence lingered, filling the air until the period of intense appliance energy ended at 05:50.
